Authorized fix, in the R33.5 packet only: restate this node as the conditional corollary whose hypothesis is the strong-form conclusion for the given rho-bar (arises from a newform of weight k(rho-bar), level N(rho-bar), character lifting eps(rho-bar)), phrased with AlgebraicModularFormsAndSerreWeights:R15.6/s-type-arises-from-and-modular; list as prerequisites that node, AlgebraicModularFormsAndSerreWeights:R15.4/weight-two-iff-finite-flat-at-p, SerreWeightAndLevelOptimisation:R20.4/nebentypus-congruent-character and R33.6/strong-form-by-the-modern-route (for the instantiation); delete both R27.6 edges; add an acceptance check that its closure reaches no R26/R27.2-R27.6 node other than R27.4/strong-form-by-minimal-lifts; update the suggested Lean signature to match. Do not add a StrongSerre definition node here (the full statement is R27.6's) and do not edit the R27.3 packet; the fixes note may tell the maintainer that R27.6's export is an instance of this corollary.

Confirmed at medium severity, with a corrected fix. DP v2 p. 7 Definition 1.10(4) makes members semisimple over K_p; Remark 4 compares two representations at the same prime after building Deligne's system for f. The node's second proof step passes from a reducible p-adic member to a reducible 2-adic member by 'Chebotarev and Brauer-Nesbitt' alone, and its fourth hypothesis asserts det rho_l = psi chi_l with psi independent of l (used for oddness); both need the classification of Hodge-Tate characters of G_Q to build 2-adic companions, a named fact that is not a prerequisite (PROTOCOL section 2). The conclusion is true. The red team missed that the bridge is already planned: PotentialModularityAndCompatibleSystems:R24.5/rank-two-reducibility-independent-of-lambda (Taylor 2006, Lemma 6.5). That node covers irreducibility but not oddness. KW I (author's preprint) p. 9 Theorem 5.1 gives an 'almost strictly compatible, irreducible, odd system' whose 2-adic member is the Theorem 5.1(1)/(2) lift, and p. 8 defines irreducible/odd as holding for every member. Authorized fix: restrict the lemma to the system of KW I Theorem 5.1(1) (k=2) or (2) (k=4), with prerequisite PotentialModularityAndCompatibleSystems:R24.5/kw-theorem-5-1-systems, and take oddness and irreducibility of every member from that theorem; delete the Chebotarev/Brauer-Nesbitt step and the psi claim. Crystallinity at odd p outside the ramification set comes from KW's almost-strict clause ('l != 2 and r_q unramified'). Say in a hypothesis that DP's Theorem 1.9 cites exactly this KW theorem, and keep the reducible-residual branch. Do not add a request for rank-one companions.

R24.3/theorem-5-1-part-1-minimal-crystalline and /theorem-5-1-part-2-weight-two are DP Theorem 1.9(1)-(2). DP Theorem 1.11 is R24.5/dieulefait-families: stage R24.5 owns constructing a system with the prescribed member. Remark 4 is R24.6/linked-systems-modularity-transfer. So the R24.6 request wrongly merges an R24.5 need with an R24.6 one. R15.6/s-type-arises-from-and-modular defines 'arises from' and N, k, eps, and leaves the eigenform comparison open. Authorized fix, in the R33.5 packet: replace the R24.3/R24.6/R32.6/R15.6 stage prerequisites in all five consuming nodes with those node ids (after finding 2 the auxiliary lemma uses R24.5/kw-theorem-5-1-systems); delete each request whose need one of these nodes states exactly; split what remains so no request names a stage for another stage's result; restate the gap as the unaudited items of R32.6/globalisation-dependency-audit, citing it; keep R33.6/modern-and-classical-modularity-agree as the eigenform/newform comparison. Keep the R17.6 and R20.6 edges and requests unchanged; no R20.6 node gives the p=2, k=4 weight-two-to-weight-four step. Do not change the supplier packets.

Confirmed at low severity; the fix scope is extended. README lines 63-65 still say that the modern route 'stops being independent of KW exactly' at the scalar dyadic case, which the accepted review corrected in the packet's node statement. The same stale wording is in README lines 12-13 ('states exactly where the strong refinement stops being independent of Khare-Wintenberger'), in the title of R33.6/two-routes-comparison ('where the modern route stops being independent of Khare-Wintenberger'), and in the packet summary. The R27.3 packet records E3-E9, including E8 and E9, so 'E3-E7' at README line 72 is stale by two ids, not one. Authorized fix: rewrite README lines 12-13 and 63-65 to match the corrected node. The four claims to keep distinct are: the qualitative argument is independent of KW's induction; both routes share KW I Theorem 5.1; both use R27.4/strong-form-by-minimal-lifts in every p odd or p=2, k=2 case; that argument is indispensable only in the scalar dyadic non-dihedral case. Retitle the node, for example 'Two proofs of Serre's conjecture: what each route uses from Khare-Wintenberger'. Reword the summary to match. Change line 72 to 'E3-E9' and keep 'no new source issue'. Presentation only; no node statement or edge changes.

Confirmed at low severity. At Mathlib 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174, Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/Basic.lean lines 74-84 define structures ModularForm and CuspForm. At Tau Ceti f790474821cf4256814db967cb154e7af3d0c369, TauCeti.cuspFormsOld is at Newforms/Basic.lean:103, structure Newform is at Newforms/Newform.lean:102, and HeckeRing.GL2.Newform.eq_of_forall_notMem_eigenvalue_eq is at Newforms/StrongMultiplicityOne.lean:87. So the note that modular forms are not in the pinned libraries is false. The Galois half stands: the declaration index has no Galois-representation carrier for G_Q (the only Tau Ceti hit is a cocharacter action of algebraic tori). Authorized fix: in the standard note of the suggested Lean file only, say that the residual Galois representations of G_Q and the Serre-modularity interface are not in the pinned libraries, and that the modular-form and newform carriers are (Mathlib ModularForm/CuspForm, Tau Ceti Newform), to be reused when the interface is built. Keep the signatures commented and the examples unchanged. The same overbroad sentence in other parts' suggested files is outside this red team's scope.
